description: React component for managing datasets, including listing, adding, editing, deleting, and pagination.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches datasets with current pagination parameters.

methods.name: goToRows
methods.description: Navigates to dataset rows page for selected dataset.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search state based on user input.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new dataset.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit selected dataset.

methods.name: deleteDataset
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a dataset, shows snackbar notifications.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Closes dialog and refreshes dataset list.

methods.name: filterDatasets
methods.description: Filters datasets based on search string.
